$comment: Authoritative Android release-versioning baseline for IRTH.
playProductionVersionCode: the versionCode of the artifact CURRENTLY serving
production on Google Play (read it in Play Console → Release → Production →
the active release → App bundles/APKs → 'Version code').
It is null because the repository contains no authoritative evidence of it.
Release builds intentionally FAIL until it is filled in.
Never lower these values. Never auto-increment them from a build script.
Only the numeric versionCode is used for update enforcement; versionName is display-only.
